zh_CN: 常来的客人，当然有常来的价钱。
en: Regular customers deserve a regular customer's price.

zh_CN: 本局商店价格-15%，每次购买商品理智-2。
en: Shop prices -15% this run; each item purchase costs 2 sanity.

zh_CN: 钱不能光放着，总得有点别的什么作用。
en: Money shouldn't just sit there. It ought to do something else.

zh_CN: 下一波受到的生命伤害-30%；每抵消1点伤害消耗{单价}本金，本金耗光后失效。
en: Next wave's health damage -30%; each point prevented costs {单价} principal. Expires when principal runs out.

zh_CN: 既然还有力气，就多做一点。
en: Since you still have strength left do a little more.

zh_CN: 下一波怪物生命+30%，存活后金币+{动态值}
en: Next wave's monster health +30%; survive to gain {动态值} gold

zh_CN: 把他解决了，我们之间的账就好商量了。
en: Deal with him and we can talk about what you owe me.

zh_CN: 下一波开始额外出现一个强力boss，击败后，欠款-{动态值}；如果时间结束未能击杀，则欠款+{动态值}
en: An extra powerful boss appears at the start of the next wave. Defeat it to reduce debt by {动态值}; if it survives the time limit debt increases by {动态值}
